Not-to-Miss School Supplies

By
Lindsay VanAsdalan
-

    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by
    0:00 / 0:45
    Instaread

    Every school and age group has different requirements when it comes to school supplies, but here are some items to add to your back-to-school list to enhance health, safety, practical use, organization and individuality.

    • Fidget Aids
    • Bento or Freezable Lunchboxes
    • Large Capacity Pencil Cases
    • Personalized Pencils with Your Child’s Name
    • Blue Light Block Glasses (to protect eyes from screens)
    • Erasable Highlighters and Pens
    • Tools for Stress Relief and Mental Health Check-Ins
    • Reusable Notebooks
    • Multicultural Skin Tone Crayons
    • Binder Ring Flash Cards
